# evroc_snapshot (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc snapshot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the snapshot was created (RFC3339 format).
- `disk_ref` (String) Reference to the source disk.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `region` (String) Region where the snapshot is located.
- `restore_size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in GB.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the snapshot.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels (read-only).
